name: Fruits
overview: Scripture reveals that fruitfulness is a divine blessing and purpose for creation, as God commanded the earth to bring forth fruit and mankind to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:11-12, 28). The fruit of the earth and trees are given by God for sustenance (Genesis 1:29), and the fruit produced by the righteous is described as a tree of life, symbolizing wisdom and spiritual vitality (Proverbs 11:30). This underscores both the natural and spiritual dimensions of fruitfulness as expressions of God's provision and human obedience.
